calculations.name: name_total_process
steps: 1. Assign values to each name individually
2. Add values for first, middle, last names separately
3. If any name sum is a single digit, do not reduce further
4. Reduce double digits to compound or single as per Scenario rules
5. Master numbers (11, 22, 33) must not be reduced

conditions.note: Reduce till compound after addition. If no compound, go back one step.

conditions.rule: Both numbers in addition row must be same digit count (both single or both double) for valid reduction
